seo.title: Lunar and Biodynamic Calendar
seo.description: Lunar biodynamic calendar for hair care at Salón Pilar Palomares. Discover the best days for your haircut and treatment.

hero.desc: When beauty follows the rhythm of nature
hero.imgAlt: Cosmos biodynamic calendar: lunar rhythms for conscious beauty

agua.desc: Just as the moon governs the tides, it also influences the water that makes up 70% of our body. At Pilar Palomares, we use this ancestral knowledge to enhance the effectiveness of each biotherapy.
agua.imgAlt: The rhythm of water and lunar influence: water nymphs under the full moon, representing the cosmobiological connection

julio.introText1: Nature opens up completely in July, showing all its potential. It is a time to care from consciousness: protecting and balancing against the intensity of the sun, heat, and exposure.
julio.introText2: Biodynamics reminds us of the importance of sustaining this rhythm from respect, accompanying the skin and hair so that they maintain their balance, hydration, and capacity for adaptation.

corte.desc: Hair responds to lunar cycles. July offers very precise windows for cutting depending on the result you seek: stimulating growth, strengthening the fiber, or simply sealing the ends with care.
corte.d4_6: Especially favorable moment to enhance the natural shape of the curl and accompany its movement with harmony and definition.
corte.d6_8: Cut for those who wish to stimulate growth and give a boost to their hair. Ascending moon: the sap rises.
corte.d12_26: Recommended periods to care for hair length, favoring healthier ends and a hair with a renewed look.
corte.d18_22: Ideal phase of the cut to strengthen the fiber and favor a greater resistance against hair loss. Perfect for those looking for density and structure.

color.desc: The moon influences how hair absorbs and retains color. Choosing the right day makes the difference between a shade that lasts and one that fades. July offers very specific windows to work on coloring with optimal results.
color.d13_14: Especially favorable moment for color: enhances its luminosity and allows hair to reflect all its beauty and naturalness.
color.d16_18: Ideal period to work on color, favoring greater fixation and helping to prolong its intensity and duration.
color.d18_22: Propitious days to apply color if you seek to enhance the depth and richness of nuances, achieving more vibrant and expressive tones.
color.d22_23: Second high-luminosity window. Ideal for balayage or highlights techniques looking for luminosity and natural reflection.

depil.desc: During the descending moon phase, hair removal finds a particularly propitious moment to delay hair growth, ensuring longer-lasting results and cared-for skin in harmony with the cosmos.
depil.d13_14: Especially favorable phase for body biodynamic hair removal.
depil.d22_23: Second ideal window to maintain skin softness for longer.
depil.imgAlt: Skin care and biodynamic hair removal in July 2026

treat.desc: Skin and body benefit greatly from synchronizing care with cosmos cycles. Tune your cabin rituals to enhance active assimilation and tissue firmness.
treat.d6_8: Ascending moon, best in the morning. Brightening and Detox treatments take advantage of higher superficial circulation.
treat.d13_22: Descending moon, best in the late afternoon/evening. Optimal for Anti-Aging, Sensitive, Straffung, and Dekolleté treatments. Skin absorbs active ingredients better.
treat.d22_26: Continuation of the descending phase. Ideal for drainage treatments, tired legs, and any body firming protocol.
